ops.title: Docs emulator rework Phases 1-3 SHIPPED on main (no release needed — docs/tests only); pocket-llm live on GitHub awaiting npm auth; Phase 4b pending
ops.body:
Docs emulator rework (plan `the-emulator-on-the-proud-narwhal.md`, cc-task 5c36f51), shipped to main 2026-07-21 — docs machinery + tests only, **no captain_hook package change, so no PyPI release was cut**:

- Phase 1 `3d26e481`: in-browser DSL compiler on @lezer/python (`docs/tutorial/_src/compiler/`) byte-mirroring `widget_compiler.compile_fragment`; multi-bundle `build_emulator.py` (emulator/compiler/editor.js, declarative BUNDLES table, npm ci + tsc); compile-parity + refusal-parity pytest axes. **Always `uv run python docs/scripts/build_emulator.py`** — bare python lacks cc_transcript (a sonnet gate agent false-alarmed on this).
- Phase 2 `55c2c7b6`: comprehensive widget (always-visible editable code panel, lazy CodeMirror via data-editor-js, 300ms recompile, ARIA combobox over all cases, chips capped at featured/first-4, hook-derived session controls, compile-error card, caseLabel fix, unified home hero). Payload contract v2: div carries data-editor-js/data-compiler-js; live payloads carry verbatim `source`.
- Review hardening `1999b3a8`: adversarial review (10 confirmed) — octal/`\N{}` escapes, ContinuedString concat, per-primitive signature specs, oracle tightened to refuse non-import/non-call top-level statements, tool_aliases drift guard.
- Phase 3 `2e46a1e1` + `f6bff0d2`: rm_walk world mode — `rm_world.ts` ports deletions.py over a declared VFS, parity byte-equal on a materialized world (**non-scratch, non-repo base — a tmpdir base makes everything scratch-allowed**; monkeypatch `trash_binary` on the discover_pack-loaded module `captain_hook._packs.general.deletions`). Divergence review confirmed 7/7 wrong-verdict findings (worst: `exec rm -rf /` PASSED); fixed under the invariant **byte-equal or honesty card, never a differing verdict, never pass-where-Python-blocks**.

Pending: **Phase 4b** (docs LLM lane: thin adapter over [[pocket-llm-library]], wasm copy into widgets/wllama/, fragment tutorial_llm_gate.py + rubric lift, page 06) — blocked on pocket-llm's npm publish. Also pending: pocket-llm social-preview upload (Touch ID browser session).

Gotchas hit: the cc-guides re-render bot pushes to main mid-wave (**always fetch+rebase --autostash before pushing**; repo has `status.aheadBehind=false` so `git status -sb` prints `[different]`, use rev-list); codex/gpt-5.6 lanes hard-down on usage limits until ~Jul 27 (all sol lanes ran on opus); reviews of a shared working copy must pin a worktree at the commit (`git worktree add ~/.cache/... <sha>`, uv run bootstraps .venv there) or reviewers observe concurrent lanes' edits; deployed tutorial URLs are un-numbered (`first-block.html`, not `01-first-block.html`) — see [[agent-browser-headless-qa]].
